About.title: About
About.intro: I am a Kuwait-based digital solutions and AI integration consultant. For more than 15 years I have worked where business meets technology: IT and network administration, IT consulting, digital media and marketing, and, since 2022, the design and delivery of AI solutions.
About.approach: That mix matters. A marketing background means I think about the people who will use a solution as much as the technology behind it, which is why the solutions I deliver get used rather than shelved.
About.experienceLine: I have experience delivering AI solutions for large enterprises and public-sector organisations.

Services.title: How I help
Services.subtitle: Three ways to work together, each focused on a business outcome rather than a technology.
Services.audience: I work with mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC with an established management team, who value quality, clear accountability and long-term results over the lowest price.

items.title: AI strategy & readiness
items.outcome: A clear, prioritised AI roadmap your leadership agrees on
items.description: We identify where AI creates real value in your business, assess how ready your data, systems and teams are, and agree which opportunities to pursue first.

items.title: AI solution delivery & integration
items.outcome: Working AI solutions connected to the systems you already use
items.description: From pilot to production: AI assistants, document intelligence, automation and model gateways, delivered and integrated with your existing platforms, securely and in Arabic and English.

items.title: Adoption & enablement
items.outcome: Teams that use the solution and leaders who can see the impact

Process.title: How we work together
Process.subtitle: A clear, four-step process, with management involved at every decision point.

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: A conversation about your goals, constraints and where AI could help. You leave with a clearer view, whether or not we work together.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We agree the scope, the success measures and the right solution for your systems, data and team.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: I build and integrate the solution in short, visible stages, so you see progress and can adjust early.

steps.title: Adopt & measure
steps.description: We roll out, train your team and follow the agreed measures, then improve based on real usage.

Portfolio.title: Typical engagements
Portfolio.subtitle: Three common types of work. Client details are kept confidential.

items.title: Turning interest in AI into a plan
items.context: Mid-sized company whose leadership is exploring AI
items.challenge: Leadership saw the potential of AI but had many ideas, no priorities and no shared view of the risks.
items.approach: Structured workshops with management and key teams, a review of data and systems, and a short list of opportunities with clear business cases.
items.outcome: A roadmap leadership agreed on, with first initiatives chosen for value and feasibility, each with a clear owner.

items.title: An AI assistant for everyday questions
items.context: Organisation handling a high volume of repetitive enquiries
items.challenge: Staff and customers spent too long looking for answers spread across documents and systems.
items.approach: An Arabic and English AI assistant grounded in the organisation's own content, connected to existing systems, with clear limits on what it answers.
items.outcome: Faster, more consistent answers, and teams free to focus on the cases that need human judgement.

items.title: Making documents searchable and usable
items.context: Organisation with a large archive of documents
items.challenge: Important information was locked inside long documents that were slow to search and hard to reuse.
items.approach: A document intelligence portal that extracts, organises and indexes content, with review steps wherever accuracy matters.
items.outcome: Information that is quick to find and reuse, with less manual effort and more consistency.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Short answers to what clients usually ask before starting.

items.question: How do engagements usually work?
items.answer: Most clients start with a short strategy and readiness phase, move on to delivering one or two priority solutions, and then to adoption support. Each phase has a defined scope and is agreed separately, so you only commit to the next step.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: It depends on scope. A readiness assessment usually takes a few weeks, and a first working solution typically follows in stages over a few months. We agree a realistic plan with clear milestones during the design step.

items.question: How do you handle data privacy and security?
items.answer: Privacy is part of the design from day one. We agree at the start which data may be used, where it is processed and who can access it, and the solution follows your internal policies and any regulations that apply to you.

items.question: Can AI work with our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. Most of my work is connecting AI to the platforms you already run, such as document stores, business applications and websites, rather than replacing them. The readiness review confirms what is practical.

items.question: Do your solutions support Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. I work in Arabic and English, and solutions are designed for both languages from the start, including right-to-left interfaces and Arabic content.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Request a discovery call through the form below or on WhatsApp. We discuss your goals and current situation, and I suggest a sensible first step.
